source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ανανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The entry is one sentence and a couplet: Saint Ananias bore witness by the sword. There is no year, no reign, no place and no companion, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and no hymn is printed. The corpus keeps four men of this name — the apostle, the one of the Three Youths, one of Crete and one of 26 January — and none of them on this day; the slug carries the day because the page gives nothing else to tell him apart by.
